title: Epic OS Skill Library

skills.name: Master Plan
skills.what: Turns a rough project or idea into a short, clear plan card with what done looks like, a grade, and a ship-or-improve decision.
skills.notes: Our own method. Uses the Score skill for the grade.

skills.name: Pressure Test Before Go
skills.what: Scores a big new tool, system, or workflow on 7 checks before anyone says go, and only allows a small pilot if the key scores are under 80.
skills.trigger: Runs automatically before any go, install, or build decision
skills.notes: Our own method.

skills.name: 90-Day Growth Plan
skills.what: Builds a 90-day plan to get a live offer in front of the right people and turn them into conversations and customers, with every task given to a named bot.
skills.trigger: "How do I get leads?" once a page is live
skills.notes: Not installed. Tom-derived. Campaign Ops owns it and hands pieces to the others.

skills.name: Demand Test Design
skills.what: Picks the one smallest test (free download, booked call, or pre-sale) that proves people want an offer before it gets built, with a win number and a quit number set up front.
skills.trigger: "How do I test this?" or after Idea Validation says GO
skills.notes: Not installed. Shaped after the Tom Bilyeu pack (personal use only), so not for clients as is.

skills.name: Idea Validation
skills.what: Proves or kills a business idea using real customer words and proof that people already pay for this, ending in GO, SHARPEN, or KILL.
skills.trigger: "Is this idea any good?" or "validate this"
skills.notes: Not installed. Tom-derived. First step of the launch chain.

skills.name: Landing Page Build
skills.what: Turns approved launch copy into one live web page with one button and a working signup form, then hands a checklist to the Reviewer before it goes public.
skills.trigger: "Publish a page" once copy is approved
skills.notes: Not installed. Tom-derived. Bot Studio Builder for client builds.

skills.name: Launch Copy
skills.what: Writes every word a launch needs (hook, page, free download, follow-up emails, posts, DMs) in the client's own voice using only real proof.
skills.trigger: After a Demand Test is picked, or any ask for a hook, page, or emails
skills.notes: Not installed. Tom-derived. Planned for Cat as she moves into Trevor's copywriter seat.

skills.name: Ed Lawrence Mentor
skills.what: Coaches Trevor on business YouTube: simple style, intros, stories that turn viewers into buyers, and views versus sales in a Ed Lawrence-style voice, using only saved quotes and videos, never pretending to be Ed Lawrence.
skills.notes: Installed, but the pack scored 56% with Reviewer, so it is held from being promoted as a finished coach. Copy also lives at /workspace/mentor-machine/skills/ed-lawrence-advisor/SKILL.md. The two copies differ slightly (need to pick one).

skills.name: Hormozi Mentor
skills.what: Coaches Trevor on offers, leads, free value, and growth in a Alex Hormozi-style voice, using only saved quotes and videos, never pretending to be Alex Hormozi.
skills.notes: Installed, but the pack scored 50% with Reviewer, so it is held from being promoted as a finished coach. Copy also lives at /workspace/mentor-machine/skills/hormozi-advisor/SKILL.md. The two copies are identical.

skills.name: Kallaway Mentor
skills.what: Coaches Trevor on YouTube, short videos, packaging, bios, and calls to action in a Kallaway-style voice, using only saved quotes and videos, never pretending to be Kallaway.
skills.notes: Installed, but the pack scored 57% with Reviewer, so it is held from being promoted as a finished coach. Copy also lives at /workspace/mentor-machine/skills/kallaway-advisor/SKILL.md. The two copies differ slightly (need to pick one).

skills.name: MrBeast Perspective (outside download)
skills.what: A free skill someone else published online (written in Chinese) that role-plays MrBeast to give YouTube title, thumbnail, and hook advice.
skills.notes: Third-party. Our MrBeast pack treats it as a guess to check, not a source. No owner bot.

skills.name: First Mate Operating System
skills.what: The rulebook for how First Mate takes a request, puts it on a Linear card with an owner and a checker, and only calls it done when there is proof.
skills.notes: Our own method, but tied to Trevor's Linear setup and Grok Bot; would need trimming for a client.

skills.name: Score
skills.what: Grades any piece of work with a letter and a percent, names the 2 to 4 gaps, and asks whether to ship it or improve it.
skills.notes: Our own method.

skills.name: Epic Skill Card Template
skills.what: The blank pattern every new skill should follow: one job, what it needs first, hard rules, steps with checks, a self-score, and a handoff note.
skills.trigger: Used when writing a new skill
skills.notes: Not installed. Structure inspired by the Tom pack, rewritten in our words; Maybe for clients after Tom says OK.

skills.name: Tango Work Loop (outside tool)
skills.what: Instructions from the Tango tool for how bots claim a task, show their work, attach proof, and hand off to the next bot or person.
skills.trigger: Only if the Tango pilot goes ahead
skills.notes: Written by Tango (a vendor), saved during a pilot. Not installed. No bot formally owns it.

skills.name: Depleted Brain Ghostwriting Playbook
skills.what: The playbook for drafting Dr. Leigh's book The Depleted Brain: table of contents patterns, launch deadlines, and rules against made-up facts.
skills.notes: A reference file the Book agent reads, not an installed skill.

skills.name: Dr. Leigh Richardson Voice
skills.what: Makes anything written in Dr. Leigh's name (book chapters, emails, posts, bios) sound warm, plain, and hopeful like her, with every science fact sourced.
skills.trigger: Any writing in Dr. Leigh's voice
skills.notes: Short installed version. Full version: /workspace/leigh-book/LEIGH-VOICE-SKILL.md (Word copy in /workspace/leigh-docx/). Still partial: blogs and LinkedIn not added yet.
